motif_annotation_note: P(motif-inferred genomic transcript strand == annotated strand). A consistency check on the alignment and the annotation, NOT the -uf gate: it is ~0.995 for stranded and unstranded libraries alike (A39).
protocol: B1 §3.3 item 2 as corrected by A39 (v1.29): -uf is gated on sense_read_fraction, the read's orientation relative to the transcript. The literal reading, motif_annotation_agreement, is retained as a diagnostic.
reason: only 5 alignments valid for an orientation call, below the floor of 1000; the frozen >= 95% rule is not applied to a sample this small
sense_read_note: P(read genomic strand == annotated strand), over alignments whose motif call agrees with the annotation. This is the proposition -uf asserts. ~0.5 unstranded; ~1.0 stranded sense; ~0.0 stranded antisense. THIS is the gate (A39).
